          }
        ],
        "paragraphs": [

The default sans stack starts with -apple-system/BlinkMacSystemFont and Segoe UI; it deliberately omits system-ui. No web font is downloaded by the framework. The documentation shell can style its own typography independently."

          "Prose is a column flex container with content-gap, a 1000px max-width and automatic inline margins. Its content-font-size and line-height tokens change at 1024px. It normalizes common margins, styles all six heading levels, links, lists, quotations, images and tables. It does not sanitize HTML or make arbitrary content accessible."
